metadata.title: पर्वत बराबर दान करने वाली आदिवासी जमींदारिन । Tanwar are Rajputs or Adivasi | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Tanwar community is in the list of scheduled tribes in Chhattisgarh, but they claim to be Rajputs. It's this interesting story that we try to explain in this episode of Main Bhi Bharat. In this episode, we met the family of the erstwhile Zamindars of Lafa village in the Korba district of Chhattisgarh.
